answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1690 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the orchard. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the ember queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The prism index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 78 pays that 263 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
